context: batch s151b builds two new briefs on decision spine v2: ocd (Obsessive-Compulsive and Related Disorders, a psychiatry disease brief) and capacity (Decision-Making Capacity and Informed Consent, a Preventive & Ethics lookup brief); this is review round 1, on each whole brief

types.capacity: lookup brief (decision-making capacity, informed consent, surrogates), fm lens; new brief; a lookup brief carries tables and a commitment rule instead of the eight spine steps (model: defense-mechanisms, s150c); review in full

read: The 5a workup zone names (First step, Targeted tests, Next step, Diagnostic test, Skip), the caption "Diagnostic workup", the caption "Look-alikes, most tempting first" and the pause point's "The bait:" label are site conventions.
Not to report: brief length or word count (2026-10-19 layers rule).

Settled by Jonathan at launch (do not report): ocd points to tics (tic-related OCD) and peds-alopecia (trichotillomania); the OCPD row has no drawer (cluster C brief on hold); capacity sends minors' consent to Adolescent Confidentiality.
Relaunch of read-A for capacity only (read-A spent its calls before writing this receipt): read brief_text.txt, then at most one Grep each of ABBREV.json and ALIASES.json, then write the receipt.
ABBREV.json is a dict whose lists labs_imaging, site_conventions and roman_numerals are the allowlist; a term absent from them is spelled out. ALIASES.json holds the other-names table under entries.
A lookup brief's pause point is one plain sentence after "Pause point." with no "The bait:" label (the shipped defense-mechanisms brief does the same).
